description: This file defines a PHP driver class for connecting to Microsoft SQL Server 2012 via ODBC within the ADOdb database abstraction library. It includes class extensions that set specific connection behaviors for the SQL Server 2012 driver.

classes.name: ADODB_odbc_mssql2012
classes.description: Driver class for Microsoft SQL Server 2012 via ODBC, extends the base MSSQL ODBC class and sets specific connection statement.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_odbc_mssql2012
classes.description: Record set class for MSSQL 2012 ODBC, inherits behavior from the MSSQL record set class.

methods.name: ADODB_odbc_mssql2012
methods.description: Constructor or class initializer, sets a connection statement to make behavior similar to earlier SQL Server versions.
